integrity: The argument uses the source's fully inspected tube interpolation, exterior-constant extension, ratio calibration, and universal Hessian bound. The new universalization is proved by dense rational target ratios, spatial rescaling that makes Hessian bounds uniform, and a locally finite disjoint-strip sum. The common-start obstruction is an independent first-step Goldstein interval argument.
scientific_limitations: The universal objective uses parameter-dependent starting points in disjoint translated copies. The common-start impossibility requires simultaneous Goldstein validity with the same first-local-minimizer first ray. The construction does not provide bounded level sets or a compact universal counterexample.
title: Universal BFGS counterexample objective with parameter-dependent starts, and a common-start obstruction
